project_name: Qloud Smart Homes / Qloud Tech - Cinetekk Editorial Redesign Blueprint

core_philosophy.intent: Precision Engineering, Architectural Whitespace, Cinematic Mood, and Intent-Driven AV Performance
core_philosophy.rule_of_thumb: Eliminate aggressive cyan glow/gradient overload; transition to deep obsidian, warm charcoal, platinum borders, surgical typography, and generous negative space.
core_philosophy.seo_preservation_guarantee: 100% of existing copy, keywords, routes, schemas, tables, FAQs, pricing, reviews, area chips, and brand names are preserved verbatim. Only design, layout, typography, surface treatment, and spacing change.

critical_code_rules: BABEL PLUGIN SAFETY: The custom visual-edits babel plugin crashes if Lucide icons are passed as PROPS (e.g., `icon={<Layers />}`). ALL icons must be rendered inline in JSX.
ALL JSX files: Ensure all files remain valid JavaScript / JSX (.jsx or .js) without TypeScript types.
TESTING ATTRIBUTES: Every button, link, form input, modal trigger, card, and pricing tier MUST have a unique kebab-case `data-testid` attribute.
NO FULL TRANSPARENT BACKGROUNDS: Dropdowns, overlays, fixed headers, and mobile drawers must use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0C0E]/90` or solid backgrounds to ensure 100% legibility.

COPY PRESERVATION: Keep all SEO copy, FAQ answers, area chips, brand partner names, package prices (₹2.29L - ₹12.39L), and customer count (450+ customers, 100+ home theatres, 5★ rating) EXACTLY AS IN EXISTING CODE.

page_by_page_redesign_strategy.homepage: Transform into the Cinetekk-style editorial narrative: Hero statement -> Heritage/Numbers bar -> Solutions by environment -> The Advantage -> Packages -> Process -> Brand Partners -> Reviews -> SEO Keyword Section (stat cards, Dolby Atmos config chips, area pills, FAQ) -> Contact & Consultation form.
page_by_page_redesign_strategy.services_hub_and_detail: Editorial hero with technical specifications overview, architectural photography, step-by-step engineering deployment, related guides, and FAQ.
page_by_page_redesign_strategy.packages_page: Tiered comparison with clear pricing (₹2.29L to ₹12.39L), component breakdown, room size suitability matrix, and lead booking trigger.
page_by_page_redesign_strategy.process_page: Engineering timeline: Acoustic Simulation -> 3D Modeling -> Cabling & Concealment -> Calibration -> Handover.
page_by_page_redesign_strategy.projects_page: High-impact editorial gallery spotlighting Bangalore villa installations with technical AV tags.
page_by_page_redesign_strategy.blog_list_and_article: Clean editorial reading layout with left-aligned sticky Table of Contents, technical summary callouts, comparison tables, and conversion quote CTA.
page_by_page_redesign_strategy.contact_and_location_pages: Monochrome architectural contact hub with direct engineer hotline, WhatsApp quick link, interactive area coverage tags, and Bangalore local business metadata.

5. Redesign Packages, Process, Projects, Contact, and Brand dealer pages.
6. Redesign Blog list and Blog article template with editorial reading typography.
7. Redesign programmatic Location pages (/:locationSlug) and Ad Landing Page (/lp/home-theatre-bangalore).

instructions_to_main_agent: Adopt the complete Cinetekk editorial aesthetic across all pages. Maintain strict SEO content fidelity. Render all icons inline to prevent babel plugin issues. Ensure all interactive components have data-testid attributes.
